resources.string:
Long-press a country heading, including the sticky heading, or press the remote Menu key to select several countries or regions. Both country windows put Select all and Deselect all at the bottom left, in the same row as the other actions. On narrow screens, swipe the action row sideways or use remote left/right to reach every button. If every selected group is hidden, the action is Unhide selected; otherwise it is Hide selected. Changes apply immediately without closing the window, so you can reverse them. Choose Close when finished.

Hide removes groups from the list but keeps pinned shortcuts, playback and saved stations. Hidden groups stay hidden after subscription updates. Use Show hidden countries to restore some or all of them.

Delete removes the selected station entries and pins, not subscription definitions. Refresh the relevant subscriptions to download their stations again, reset embedded stations to restore built-ins, or re-import your local file. Current playback is not interrupted.

This also removes their pins and cached subscription entries. Subscription definitions and other countries are kept. Refresh the relevant subscriptions to restore their stations, reset embedded stations to restore built-ins, or re-import your local file. Current playback continues. Hidden-country preferences are not changed.
Deleted %1$d station entries. Refresh subscriptions or reset embedded stations to recover their entries.
Selected countries are hidden from the grouped list. Pinned shortcuts and playback are unchanged.
Matching countries are hidden. Use Radio settings to show hidden countries.
